categories.main_business_segments: The company is primarily engaged in the research, development, production, and sales of stage entertainment lighting equipment, architectural lighting equipment, and trusses. The main products include stage entertainment lighting fixtures (such as pattern lights, color lights, and beam lights), architectural lighting equipment for urban landscape illumination, and aluminum alloy truss structures used for stage construction and fixture suspension.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company possesses multiple self-developed core technologies including high-precision light cutting technology, dynamic humidity balance technology, ultra-wideband positioning technology, human body posture prediction, and precise rapid tracking. The company employs both order-based production and non-order-based production methods. Manufacturing involves assembly of electronic components, optical systems, mechanical structures, and control systems, with some non-core processes outsourced to external manufacturers.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers include television stations, theaters, concert halls, sports venues, entertainment venues, tourism performance operators, enterprises with internal stages, and stage lighting equipment rental companies. The company also serves engineering solution providers for stage lighting. End markets include large-scale entertainment events, concerts, theatrical performances, theme parks, and urban landscape lighting projects.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters in Guangzhou. It has established subsidiaries and operations in Hong Kong, France, Germany, Denmark, United States, and Vietnam. The company maintains sales and after-sales service centers in major domestic cities and operates globally with significant overseas presence, particularly in Asia, Africa, South America, Middle East, and Eastern Europe.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the midstream to downstream segments of the supply chain. It sources raw materials and components from upstream suppliers, manufactures finished products through its own production facilities and outsourced partners, and sells directly to end-users, engineering solution providers, and through distributors in both domestic and international markets.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company focuses on continuous innovation in professional stage lighting and intelligent lighting equipment. Key R&D initiatives include developing high-precision optical systems, advanced control technologies, lightweight designs, waterproof systems, laser lighting technology, automatic tracking systems, and intelligent interactive lighting solutions. The company emphasizes digitalization, networking, and smart control capabilities in its product development.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through product sales using a buy-out sales model. Revenue is recognized when customers obtain control of goods, either upon delivery and acceptance for simple products or upon installation and system commissioning for complex systems. The company operates both OBM (Original Brand Manufacturing) and ODM (Original Design Manufacturing) business models, serving both domestic and international markets.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with both international and domestic manufacturers of stage lighting equipment. Major international competitors include established European and American lighting equipment manufacturers. The company positions itself as a leading domestic manufacturer with competitive advantages in product quality, technological innovation, and cost-effectiveness. It holds significant market share in China and is expanding its international presence.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company is a mid-to-large sized manufacturer with 2024 revenue of approximately 1.21 billion yuan, representing a 7.12% decline from 2023. Net profit attributable to parent company shareholders was approximately 301.7 million yuan in 2024, down 17.61% from 2023. The company has total assets of approximately 2.72 billion yuan and net assets of approximately 2.42 billion yuan as of December 31, 2024. The company has experienced steady growth historically but faced headwinds in 2024.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates itself through advanced optical and electronic technologies, high-quality manufacturing standards, comprehensive product portfolios, and strong brand recognition. Key value propositions include superior light quality and optical effects, reliable and durable products suitable for demanding professional environments, innovative control systems, and comprehensive technical support. The company emphasizes its role as a national cultural export enterprise and cultural industry demonstration base, combining manufacturing excellence with cultural industry integration.
